content.overview: Section 118 requires minutes of general meetings, board meetings and resolutions by circulation, signed and kept as prescribed.
content.glance: Section 118 requires minutes of general meetings, board meetings and resolutions by circulation, signed and kept as prescribed.
content.study: Minutes are evidence of the proceedings. They must be entered within thirty days. Tampering or failure to keep minutes attracts the penalty in the section. Members may inspect general-meeting minutes under s. 119. Secretarial standards notified under s. 118(10) are mandatory to the extent notified.
